title: Kadyal jawaan ka laasha sarwar utha rahe hain
body:
KADYAL JAWAAN KA LAASHA SARWAR UTHA RAHE HAIN
SHAADI KA TERE ARMAAN DIL HI MEIN REHGAYA HAI, HASRAT NIKAL NA PAAYI AUR MARNE JA RAHE HAIN
BABA SALAME AKHIR AKBAR KA LIJIYEGA, SUNTE HI IS SADA KO SHEH LADKHADA RAHE HAIN
CHAROON TARAF SE HAMLA AKBAR PA HORAHA HAI , TASWEER MUSTAFA KI ZALIM MITA RAHE HAIN
<<DIVIDER>>
MARNE SE TERE BETA BINAEE JA CHOOKI HAI, UTHTE NAHIN QADAM AB PHIR BHI UTHTA RAHE HAIN
LAASHA PISAR KA HAI HAI KOI NAHIN BATATA, BOO SUNGTE HUE SHEH LAASHE PA JARAHE HAIN
KIASE UTHAYE LAASHA ABBAS BHI NAHIN HAI, BACCHO MADAD KO AOO SARWAR BULA RAHE HAIN
LAASHA PA NOUJAWAAN KE LAILA KA THA YE NOUHA, KISKE SAHARE BETA TUM CHHODE JARAHE HAIN
<<DIVIDER>>
BETA GUZAR GAYA TOH KYA LUFT ZINDAGI KA, KHAIME MEIN SHAHE DEEN ROKAR SUNA RAHEIN HAIN
SAARA JAHAAN NAZAR MEIN ANDHER HOGAYA HAI, AKBAR TUMHARE PICHHE BABA BHI AARAHE HAIN
AAYE MOOSAVI SHAHE DEEN BOLE BAHEN SE ROKAR, BETA GUZAR GAYA AUR HUM MARNE JARAHE HAIN
